description.value: Chong Lee Market is a family-owned Chinese grocery store founded in 1987, now anchored at its Renfrew-Collingwood location on Rupert Street. The store carries a broad range of Asian and multicultural grocery products, fresh seafood, and produce alongside an in-house Chinese BBQ counter, hot foods, and a Vietnamese deli with made-to-order banh mi. It is a well-established neighbourhood supermarket offering a fuller pantry stop than a typical convenience store.

bike_parking_detail: 7 racks within 100m: stands (15 spaces, covered) at 20m; stands (2 spaces) at 48m; stands (2 spaces) at 50m; stands (2 spaces) at 51m; rack (3 spaces) at 58m; stands (4 spaces) at 72m; rack (7 spaces) at 73m. Total: 35 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content at chonglee.ca confirms the Rupert Street location (3818 Rupert St, Vancouver, 604-432-6880), that the store is open and active (copyright 1987-2025, upcoming 10% off dates in June 2026), and that it carries fresh groceries, Chinese BBQ, hot food, and Vietnamese deli/banh mi. No mention of bike parking, bike racks, water refill, or other cyclist-specific amenities appears anywhere on the site; the only parking reference is a car-parking registration notice for the Impark lot. OSM had no phone number on file, so the website value is used directly.
concerns: OSM record had no phone number; phone 604-432-6880 taken from website contact page for the Rupert Street location.
Address in OSM lacked postal code; full postal code V5R 6E4 taken from website contact page.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible supermarket with confirmed address and current website. A useful resupply stop for touring cyclists in the Renfrew-Collingwood area.
